name: litro-prototype-tools
description: The .fig <-> HTML pipeline for this prototype, installed from the design-prototype skill (toolkit 6.0.0). The screens themselves need none of this: they are static HTML that opens from file://. These dependencies exist only for the generators — DOM dumps, the Figma export, the changelog, the use-case documentation and the comment-dump CLI.
//: Versions follow the toolkit manifest, pinned to their major so a breaking bump cannot
arrive silently. kiwi-schema matters most: it is a 0.x package, so the caret pins the
minor as well — a change in what the encoder emits shows up as Figma hanging at
'0 of 1 files' with no error message at all.
The Node floor is >=22 because the generator needs zlib.zstdCompressSync for the data
chunk; with deflate, Figma accepts the file and never finishes opening it.
firebase-admin is only used by tools/comments.js (the stakeholder-comment dump and
reply CLI). It is declared here so `npm ci` produces a working checkout, but nothing
in the screen or export path loads it.
//overrides: uuid override: advisory 1119441 (buffer bounds in v3/v5/v6) reaches us only through @google-cloud/* transitive deps of firebase-admin@14, which still resolve uuid<11.1.1. Remove the override once `npm ls uuid` shows every path at >=11.1.1 without it.
